{"compatibility":"major","safety_note_md":"# SafeStan Safety Note

Compatibility: major.

Protected data: `y`.

Generated files: none.

Reason: the likelihood for the observed data is the built-in statement `y ~ normal(y_hat, sigma_y)`, so `y` is the protected interface variable. The early transformed-parameters read of `y` in `e_y = y - y_hat` could be handled mechanically with a deterministic data copy, but the model also declares `beta` as an unconstrained parameter with no sampling statement and no contribution to the density. SafeStan requires every parameter to have exactly one built-in prior before use. Adding a proper prior for `beta` would change the posterior, and there is no exact built-in improper flat prior over `real` vectors. Removing `beta` would change the parameter space. Therefore a SafeStan version would require a substantive model/density change rather than a minor same-density rewrite.
","model_safe_stan":"","data_safe_json":"","protected_variables":[]}

data_safe_json.description: Valid JSON object text for data_safe.json, or empty string for major rewrites.

model_safe_stan.description: Full model_safe.stan content, or empty string for major rewrites.

protected_variables.description: Top-level data variables to pass to --sstan-protect.
